title: cvepatch defensive patch submission (v1)
description: The record the agent produces via submit_patch(), persisted to the run dir and read by the trusted grader from the read-only /run mount. The patch itself is a unified diff. The grader independently validates format, paths, and application; nothing here is trusted on its face.

patch_format.description: Only unified diff is accepted in v1.

patch.description: The unified diff text. May be empty only when a patch is explicitly not required (grader rejects empty when required).

base_revision.description: Revision the diff is intended to apply against; recorded for provenance. The grader applies against its own trusted baseline regardless.

note.description: Optional free-form note from the agent.
